title: An equivariant classical density functional for ionic fluids at complex interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.28501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting the combined effects of ionic packing and long-range electrostatics at complex interfaces is technologically important, but remains challenging without atomistic simulations. Here we present a machine-learned classical density functional for ionic fluids that combines a symmetry-adapted neural free energy for short-range correlations with explicit long-range electrostatics. Trained on three-dimensional equilibrium densities and bulk correlations of the full-Coulomb restricted primitive model, a single functional transfers to charge-patterned particles and atomically structured electrodes. Around anisotropic charged solutes, it reproduces the ionic structure and mean forces from molecular dynamics, including reversals of the bare electrostatic force. At metal electrodes, self-consistent coupling to metal atoms captures the redistribution of ionic and electrode charge and the loading-dependent capacitance enhancement produced

translated_title: 复杂界面上离子流体的等变经典密度泛函理论
translated_abstract: 预测离子堆积与长程静电作用在复杂界面上的联合效应在技术上十分重要，但在缺乏原子级模拟的情况下仍然极具挑战性。本文提出了一个机器学习的离子流体经典密度泛函，它将用于短程关联的对称性自适应神经自由能与显式处理的长程静电相结合。通过对全库仑受限原始模型的三维平衡密度和体相关联进行训练，该单一泛函能够迁移应用于电荷图案化颗粒和原子结构电极。在各向异性带电溶质周围，它重现了分子动力学模拟得到的离子结构和平均力，包括裸静电力的反转现象。在金属电极处，与金属原子的自洽耦合捕获了离子与电极电荷的重新分布，以及随负载变化的电容增强效应（原文此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种机器学习的等变经典密度泛函，将对称性自适应神经自由能与显式长程静电相结合，能够从体相库仑离子流体训练出发，准确预测带电图案化颗粒和金属电极等复杂界面处离子流体的结构、平均力及电容响应。
en_tdlr: A machine-learned equivariant classical density functional that combines symmetry-adapted neural free energy with explicit long-range electrostatics, trained only on bulk Coulomb ionic fluids, accurately predicts ionic structure, mean forces, and capacitance response at complex interfaces such as charge-patterned particles and metal electrodes.
